Name: Exodilla Hunter
Information:
**Exodilla**

Pods of exodilla remain scattered in the universe, living nomadic lives as scavengers among the stars. These groups are not unlike the more savage lizardfolk of Somnus Domina, who see other species as prey to be hunted or invaders to be defended against.

**Exodilla Hunter**

The hunters of the wild exodilla pods are large, dangerous leaders of their communities. They are powerful and capable scavengers who are ready to put their lives on the line for the safety and success of their brethren, and act monstrously toward their prey.

traits.name: Frenzied Assault
traits.description: When the exodilla rolls a d20 result less than 5 on an attack roll, it rolls a new d20 and uses it as the new result.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The exodilla makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Corrosive Globula (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The exodilla spits a burst of acid at a point it can see within 40 feet. Each creature within a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Leap (2/Rest)
bonus_actions.description: The exodilla leaps up to 15 feet high over obstacles, landing in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. When it lands, it immediately makes one Claw attack against a target within range as part of the same bonus action.
